items.title: Puka Nacua: Lands on injured reserve
items.description:
The Rams placed Nacua (knee) on injured reserve Thursday, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Mike Evans: Close to returning from injury
items.description:
Coach Kyle Shanahan said Thursday that Evans is "real close" to returning from Achilles tendinitis and that he would probably be playing Sunday if it were a playoff game, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drew Lock: Remains limited in practice
items.description:
Lock (right elbow/oblique) practiced in a limited capacity Thursday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
